archive_description_definition: Description of the effect under investigation (e.g., x is associated with y, x leads to y), possibly a part of the original publication's title (abstract claim)
archive_n_definition: Study sample size used for the critical test after exclusions; observation versus contributor unit not further fixed.
scope: The archive corroborates that a description can be an abstract/original-claim label, supporting the held extension-item scope. It is additional local context, not a silently substituted frozen FReD contract. It does not identify extension rows by values or order, establish a universal sample unit, or authorise new acquisition.
